The customer service organization uses the HC ONESAP SPS service globally to ship service parts to customers. The service uses MP1 to create sales and purchase orders and performs availability check of materials using MPA (APO GATP) before scheduling deliveries.  The most critical components of the Service are its interface with third-party logistics providers like DHL and UPS and the connectivity with MPA (APO GATP).The Service depends on the SPM planning tool, which plans procurement of service parts based on demand from MP1. The planning tool creates POs in MP1 using the One PI interface.  Finally, the service also uses MPM to create and manage materials and associated master data. These materials are fed to MP1 via One PO / ITaaP.
The SPM Service primarily supports the spare parts planning team within the CLS Domain. The team uses the PTC Servigistics application for spare parts planning for all BU’s within health systems

MDM is a foundational enterprise capability that enables the creation, governance, distribution, and maintenance of trusted master data across Philips. It ensures that critical business data remains consistent, accurate, and available across applications, business processes, and reporting platforms. The service encompasses Product Master Data, Business Partner Master Data (Customer and Vendor), Finance, Organization and Reference Data (FORD), Data Quality, Data Governance, Workflow Management, and Master Data Integration capabilities. These capabilities are commonly delivered through platforms known within Philips as PDH (Product Data Hub), BPDH (Business Partner Data Hub), and FORDH (Finance, Organization and Reference Data Hub).

The customer service organization uses the HC ONESAP SPS service globally to ship service parts to customers. The service uses MP1 to create sales and purchase orders and performs availability check of materials using MPA (APO GATP) before scheduling deliveries.  The most critical components of the Service are its interface with third-party logistics providers like DHL and UPS and the connectivity with MPA (APO GATP).The Service depends on the SPM planning tool, which plans procurement of service parts based on demand from MP1. The planning tool creates POs in MP1 using the One PI interface.  Finally, the service also uses MPM to create and manage materials and associated master data. These materials are fed to MP1 via One PO / ITaaP.
The SPM Service primarily supports the spare parts planning team within the CLS Domain. The team uses the PTC Servigistics application for spare parts planning for all BU’s within health systems

MDM is a foundational enterprise capability that enables the creation, governance, distribution, and maintenance of trusted master data across Philips. It ensures that critical business data remains consistent, accurate, and available across applications, business processes, and reporting platforms. The service encompasses Product Master Data, Business Partner Master Data (Customer and Vendor), Finance, Organization and Reference Data (FORD), Data Quality, Data Governance, Workflow Management, and Master Data Integration capabilities. These capabilities are commonly delivered through platforms known within Philips as PDH (Product Data Hub), BPDH (Business Partner Data Hub), and FORDH (Finance, Organization and Reference Data Hub).

3. HS Services and HS Marketing CoEs  are allocated based on the  Share of Revenue for AOP normalized to HS BUs only (PD, IGT, Monitoring, EI).
4. Others are allocated based on the Share of Revenue for AOP.

The customer service organization uses the HC ONESAP SPS service globally to ship service parts to customers. The service uses MP1 to create sales and purchase orders and performs availability check of materials using MPA (APO GATP) before scheduling deliveries.  The most critical components of the Service are its interface with third-party logistics providers like DHL and UPS and the connectivity with MPA (APO GATP).The Service depends on the SPM planning tool, which plans procurement of service parts based on demand from MP1. The planning tool creates POs in MP1 using the One PI interface.  Finally, the service also uses MPM to create and manage materials and associated master data. These materials are fed to MP1 via One PO / ITaaP.
The SPM Service primarily supports the spare parts planning team within the CLS Domain. The team uses the PTC Servigistics application for spare parts planning for all BU’s within health systems

MDM is a foundational enterprise capability that enables the creation, governance, distribution, and maintenance of trusted master data across Philips. It ensures that critical business data remains consistent, accurate, and available across applications, business processes, and reporting platforms. The service encompasses Product Master Data, Business Partner Master Data (Customer and Vendor), Finance, Organization and Reference Data (FORD), Data Quality, Data Governance, Workflow Management, and Master Data Integration capabilities. These capabilities are commonly delivered through platforms known within Philips as PDH (Product Data Hub), BPDH (Business Partner Data Hub), and FORDH (Finance, Organization and Reference Data Hub).
